title: Annotatio V §.VI: Ecclesiastically tolerable only if agreed with Foundation and Fundamentals
pass_a_gloss: otherwise, whoever is to be tolerated ecclesiastically must necessarily agree with the Foundation of the Faith and the Fundamentals of the Christian Religion:
pass_b_english: Otherwise, anyone to be tolerated in the church must already agree with the Foundation of the Faith and the Fundamentals of the Christian religion.
Without that agreement, ecclesiastical tolerance does not even begin.
source_text: alioquin, qui tolerandus Ecclesiasticè est, ei cum Fundamento Fidei & Fundamentalibus Christianae Religionis convenire necesse est:
